Bambu Lab PA6-CF (Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polyamide 6) is the industry benchmark filament for 3D printing functional firearm components, including Glock frames, AR-15 lower receivers, and PCC chassis. Carbon fiber chopped strands impart incredible tensile strength, virtually eliminate layer warping, and produce an exceptional matte black finish with imperceptible layer lines.

Key Technical Properties:

  • Reinforcement: 20% Chopped High-Modulus Carbon Fiber
  • Heat Deflection Temperature (HDT): 180°C (0.45 MPa)
  • Recommended Nozzle Temp: 280°C – 300°C (Hardened Steel Required)
  • Recommended Bed Temp: 80°C – 100°C with Engineering Plate
  • Drying Requirement: 80°C for 8-12 hours in active dryer (AMS compatible)

de.name: Bambu Lab PA6-CF Carbon-Nylon Filament (1kg Spule)
de.short_description: Das ultimative technische Filament für 3D-gedruckte Waffenrahmen und Gehäuse. 20% carbonfaserverstärktes Nylon mit 180°C Wärmeformbeständigkeit und maximaler Zähigkeit.
de.description: Bambu Lab PA6-CF ist die erste Wahl für beanspruchte 3D-Druck-Waffenteile wie Glock-Griffstücke und AR-15 Lower. Die Carbonfaserverstärkung verhindert Verzug, erhöht die Steifigkeit drastisch und sorgt für eine elegante mattschwarze Textur.

nl.name: Bambu Lab PA6-CF Koolstofvezel Nylon Filament (1kg Spoel)
nl.short_description: Het toonaangevende filament voor zelfgeprinte vuurwapenonderdelen en frames. 20% koolstofvezel versterkt nylon met 180°C hittebestendigheid en hoge slagvastheid.
nl.description: PA6-CF van Bambu Lab is speciaal ontworpen voor zware mechanische toepassingen. Biedt uitstekende laaghechting, minimale krimp en een hoogwaardige matte afwerking voor duurzame ontvangers.

fr.name: Filament Bambu Lab PA6-CF Nylon Fibre de Carbone (Bobine 1kg)
fr.short_description: Le thermoplastique technique de référence pour carcasses et boîtiers d'armes 3D. Nylon PA6 renforcé à 20% de fibre de carbone, résistance 180°C et rigidité extrême.
fr.description: Le filament Bambu Lab PA6-CF combine la ténacité du nylon et la rigidité du carbone pour imprimer des carcasses Glock et lower AR-15 indestructibles. Finition mate haut de gamme sans lignes de couches apparentes.

es.name: Filamento Bambu Lab PA6-CF Nylon Fibra de Carbono (Bobina 1kg)
es.short_description: El filamento de ingeniería por excelencia para armazones y receptores 3D. Nylon reforzado con 20% de fibra de carbono, resistencia térmica hasta 180°C y máxima rigidez.
es.description: Bambu Lab PA6-CF ofrece la resistencia al impacto y rigidez estructural necesarias para armas de fuego impresas en 3D. Minimiza la deformación y proporciona un acabado negro mate profesional.

it.name: Filamento Bambu Lab PA6-CF Nylon Fibra di Carbonio (Bobina 1kg)
it.short_description: Il materiale ingegneristico ideale per fusti e carcasse 3D. Nylon PA6 con 20% di fibra di carbonio, resistenza termica fino a 180°C ed elevata resilienza agli urti.
it.description: La scelta d'elezione per stampare lower AR-15 e fusti Glock resistenti e precisi. L'aggiunta di fibra di carbonio elimina le deformazioni da ritiro termico donando una superficie ruvida e opaca professionale.

pl.name: Filament Bambu Lab PA6-CF Nylon Włókno Węglowe (Szpula 1kg)
pl.short_description: Wiodący filament konstrukcyjny do druku szkieletów broni i komór zamkowych. Nylon PA6 wzmocniony w 20% włóknem węglowym, odporność do 180°C i potężna udarność.
pl.description: Bambu Lab PA6-CF gwarantuje najwyższą sztywność i odporność mechaniczną niezbędną do szkieletów pistoletów i karabinków PCC. Eliminuje skurcz termiczny, dając gładkie, matowe wykończenie.

bg.name: Филамент Bambu Lab PA6-CF Карбонов Найлон (Шпула 1kg)
bg.short_description: Инженерен термопласт за 3D принтирани оръжейни рами и корпуси. Найлон PA6 с 20% въглеродни влакна, термична устойчивост 180°C и висока якост на удар.
bg.description: Златният стандарт за здрави Glock рами и AR-15 долни приемници. Въглеродните влакна придават изключителна твърдост, елиминират деформациите и осигуряват матов черен финиш.

en.name: AR-15 80% Lower Multi-Platform Router Jig Kit
en.short_description: Heavy-duty CNC-machined red anodized router jig kit for finishing forged and billet 80% AR-15 lower receivers. Includes precision steel drill bushings, top router guide plates, hardware, and solid carbide end mill.
en.description:
The AR-15 80% Router Jig Kit is the premier milling system for finishing 80% forged, billet, and polymer lower receivers at home with a handheld compact wood router. Constructed from heat-treated aircraft billet aluminum with wear-resistant hardened steel guide bushings, this jig ensures pinpoint trigger pocket depth and perfect pin hole alignment.

Package Contents:

  • Left & Right Anodized Aluminum Side Plates with Steel Bushings
  • Multi-Depth Top Router Guide Template System
  • 1/4" Solid Carbide End Mill with Built-in Depth Stop Guide
  • Trigger & Safety Selector Guide Drill Bushing Inserts
  • High-Strength Assembly Hardware & Step-by-Step Machining Guide

de.name: AR-15 80% Lower Frässchablonen-Satz (Router Jig Kit)
de.short_description: CNC-gefräster roter Aluminium-Fräsbock zur Fertigstellung von 80% AR-15 Lower Receivern. Mit gehärteten Stahlbuchsen, Tiefenanschlag und VHM-Schaftfräser.
de.description: Professionelle Vorrichtung zur präzisen Bearbeitung von 80% AR-15 Gehäusen mit einer Oberfräse. Gewährleistet exakte Abzugsabmessungen und fehlerfreie Bohrungen für Abzug- und Sicherungsstifte.

nl.name: AR-15 80% Lower Freesmal Malset (Router Jig Kit)
nl.short_description: Robuuste geanodiseerde freesmal voor het afwerken van 80% AR-15 lower receivers. Inclusief geharde stalen boorbussen, sjablonen en hardmetalen frees.
nl.description: Maakt het mogelijk om 80% kasten thuis nauwkeurig te bewerken met een handfrees. Voorzien van slijtvaste stalen bussen voor kaarsrechte paspennen en een exacte trekkerafwerking.

fr.name: Gabarit d'Usinage AR-15 Lower 80% (Kit Router Jig)
fr.short_description: Gabarit en aluminium anodisé usiné CNC pour la finition des récepteurs AR-15 80%. Comprend douilles en acier trempé, plaques guides et fraise carbure monobloc.
fr.description: Le système ultime pour usiner vos boîtiers inférieurs 80% à l'aide d'une défonceuse standard. Garantit des tolérances chirurgicales pour le logement de détente et les goupilles de sécurité.

es.name: Plantilla de Fresado para AR-15 Lower 80% (Kit Router Jig)
es.short_description: Plantilla de aluminio anodizado CNC para terminar receptores inferiores AR-15 al 80%. Incluye casquillos de acero endurecido, guías y fresa de carburo sólido.
es.description: Permite fresar receptores inferiores 80% forjados o billet con una fresadora doméstica. Garantiza profundidad exacta de la caja de disparo y alineación milimétrica de pasadores.

it.name: Dima di Fresatura AR-15 Lower 80% (Router Jig Kit)
it.short_description: Dima in alluminio anodizzato lavorata al CNC per completare lower receiver AR-15 all'80%. Include boccole in acciaio temperato, piastre guida e fresa in metallo duro.
it.description: Sistema collaudato per completare lower receiver 80% con la massima precisione meccanica. Consente di realizzare la tasca di scatto e i fori dei perni con tolleranze perfette.

pl.name: Przyrząd Frezarski do AR-15 80% Lower (Router Jig Kit)
pl.short_description: Precyzyjny szablon z anodowanego aluminium CNC do wykańczania komór spustowych AR-15 80%. Zawiera hartowane tuleje stalowe, szablony i frez węglikowy.
pl.description: Umożliwia precyzyjne wyfrezowanie gniazda mechanizmu spustowego w komorach 80% za pomocą frezarki górnowrzecionowej. Hartowane tuleje gwarantują idealną prostopadłość otworów montażowych.

bg.name: Фрезова Шаблонен Комплект за AR-15 80% Lower (Router Jig)
bg.short_description: Масивен фрезован CNC шаблон от анодизиран алуминий за довършване на AR-15 80% долни приемници. Включва закалени стоманени втулки и карбиден фрезер.
bg.description: Инструментален кондуктор за точно домашно изрязване на леглото на ударно-спускателния механизъм. Гарантира перфектно съосие на отворите за щифтовете и надеждност на сглобката.

en.name: Hardened Steel High-Temp Nozzle Upgrade Kit (0.4mm & 0.6mm)
en.short_description: Wear-resistant hardened tool steel nozzle upgrade kit engineered for abrasive filaments like Nylon Carbon Fiber (PA-CF) and glow-in-the-dark blends. Rated up to 500°C with bimetallic heatbreak and high-temp silicone sock.
en.description:
Standard brass nozzles erode rapidly when printing abrasive carbon-fiber-filled filaments, causing layer degradation and ruined receiver dimensions. This hardened steel nozzle kit upgrades your 3D printer with Rockwell C 60-rated tool steel nozzles capable of extruding hundreds of hours of PA-CF without dimensional drift.

Kit Specifications:

  • Nozzle Sizes: 1× 0.4mm and 1× 0.6mm Hardened Tool Steel Nozzles
  • Thermal Rating: Up to 500°C continuous operating temperature
  • Heatbreak: Bimetallic Copper-Titanium thermal barrier
  • Accessories: Heat-resistant silicone insulation sock and 7mm brass nozzle wrench
  • Compatibility: Bambu Lab, Creality, Anycubic, and standard V6 / Volcano hotends

de.name: Gehärtete Stahldüsen Upgrade-Satz Hochtemperatur (0.4mm & 0.6mm)
de.short_description: Verschleißfeste Werkzeugstahldüsen für abrasive Carbon- und Glasfaser-Filamente. Bis 500°C belastbar mit Bimetall-Heatbreak und Hochtemperatur-Silikonsocke.
de.description: Messingdüsen verschleißen bei Nylon-Carbonfaser in wenigen Druckstunden. Dieses gehärtete Stahl-Upgrade garantiert maßhaltige Waffenrahmen über hunderte Betriebsstunden hinweg.

nl.name: Gehard Stalen Nozzle Upgrade Set Hoge Temperatuur (0.4mm & 0.6mm)
nl.short_description: Slijtvaste nozzles van gehard gereedschapsstaal voor schurende koolstofvezelfilamenten. Bestand tot 500°C met bimetalen heatbreak en siliconen sok.
nl.description: Voorkomt slijtage bij het printen van PA-CF en andere abrasieve materialen. Behoudt exact de juiste spuitopening voor consistente wanddiktes van uw vuurwapenonderdelen.

fr.name: Kit de Buses en Acier Trempé Haute Température (0.4mm & 0.6mm)
fr.short_description: Buses ultra-résistantes à l'abrasion pour filaments nylon carbone et composites. Conçues pour des températures jusqu'à 500°C avec chaussette en silicone et heatbreak bimétal.
fr.description: Le composant indispensable pour imprimer des carcasses en nylon carbone sans usure prématurée. Assure une extrusion fluide et un diamètre de sortie inaltéré sur la durée.

es.name: Kit de Boquillas de Acero Endurecido Alta Temperatura (0.4mm y 0.6mm)
es.short_description: Boquillas resistentes al desgaste para filamentos abrasivos de fibra de carbono. Clasificadas hasta 500°C con barrera térmica bimetálica y funda de silicona.
es.description: Evita el desgaste que sufren las boquillas de latón al imprimir fibra de carbono. Mantiene tolerancias dimensionales exactas en armazones y accesorios tácticos.

it.name: Kit Ugelli in Acciaio Temperato Alta Temperatura (0.4mm e 0.6mm)
it.short_description: Ugelli antiusura in acciaio per utensili progettati per filamenti caricati in fibra di carbonio. Resistenti fino a 500°C con gola bimetallica e calza in silicone.
it.description: Indispensabile per stampare materiali tecnici compositi senza degradazione dell'orifizio. Assicura flusso costante e pareti uniformi per carcasse e fusti Glock.

pl.name: Zestaw Dysz ze Stali Hartowanej Wysokotemperaturowy (0.4mm i 0.6mm)
pl.short_description: Odporne na ścieranie dysze ze stali narzędziowej do filamentów z włóknem węglowym i szklanym. Praca do 500°C z bimetalicznym łącznikiem i osłoną silikonową.
pl.description: Standardowe dysze mosiężne ulegają natychmiastowemu wytarciu przy druku PA-CF. Dysze ze stali hartowanej zapewniają stabilną średnicę wytłaczania przez setki godzin pracy.

bg.name: Комплект Дюзи от Закалена Стомана Високотемпературни (0.4mm и 0.6mm)
bg.short_description: Износоустойчиви дюзи от закалена инструментална стомана за карбонови и абразивни нишки. Издържат до 500°C с биметален термопрекъсвач и силиконов чорап.
bg.description: Задължителен ъпгрейд за печат на карбонов найлон. Запазва точния диаметър на отвора без разширяване и гарантира фабрична точност на детайлите.

en.name: High-Impact PLA+ Pro Firearm 3D Filament (1kg Spool)
en.short_description: Formulated specifically for 3D printed firearm frames, magazines, and grips. Delivers up to 9x greater Charpy impact toughness than standard PLA, superior inter-layer bonding, and tight ±0.02mm diameter consistency.
en.description:
PLA+ Pro Firearm Grade is modified with high-performance impact modifiers that prevent the catastrophic brittle fracture typical of standard PLA. Widely proven in the DIY firearms community across thousands of rounds, it is the #1 recommended filament for beginners building Glock frames and FGC-9 receivers.

Key Material Highlights:

  • Impact Strength: High Charpy notched impact resistance (up to 9× standard PLA)
  • Layer Adhesion: Exceptional Z-axis weld strength when printed at 215°C – 230°C
  • Dimensional Precision: Consistent 1.75mm diameter with laser-verified ±0.02mm tolerance
  • Bed Adhesion: Zero warping on heated textured PEI beds at 55°C – 65°C
  • Color: Tactical Olive Drab (OD Green) and Matte Black available

de.name: Hochschlagfestes PLA+ Pro Waffen-Filament (1kg Spule)
de.short_description: Speziell modifiziert für Waffenrahmen, Magazine und Griffe. Bis zu 9-fach höhere Schlagzähigkeit als Standard-PLA und hervorragende Schichthaftung.
de.description: PLA+ Pro ist der bewährte Standard für 3D-gedruckte Griffstücke und Gehäuse. Modifikatoren verhindern sprödes Splittern und bieten hervorragende Dämpfung bei Schussabgabe.

nl.name: Slagvast PLA+ Pro Vuurwapen Filament (1kg Spoel)
nl.short_description: Speciaal geformuleerd voor zelfbouw frames, magazijnen en grips. Tot 9x hogere slagvastheid dan standaard PLA met superieure tussenlaagshechting.
nl.description: Het meest gebruikte en betrouwbare filament voor Glock-frames en FGC-9 assemblages. Voorkomt bros breken en zorgt voor een taaie, slagvaste constructie.

fr.name: Filament Haute Résistance PLA+ Pro pour Armes (Bobine 1kg)
fr.short_description: Formulé spécialement pour carcasses, chargeurs et poignées 3D. Résistance aux chocs jusqu'à 9 fois supérieure au PLA standard et excellente cohésion inter-couches.
fr.description: Le filament recommandé pour débuter dans l'impression de carcasses d'armes. Ses additifs anti-choc évitent les ruptures nettes et absorbent le recul de tir de manière optimale.

es.name: Filamento PLA+ Pro Alta Resistencia al Impacto (Bobina 1kg)
es.short_description: Diseñado especialmente para armazones, cargadores y empuñaduras impresas en 3D. Resistencia al impacto hasta 9 veces superior al PLA convencional.
es.description: El material de referencia para proyectos de bricolaje de armas. Su formulación tenaz evita fracturas frágiles bajo retroceso y proporciona una adhesión entre capas inigualable.

it.name: Filamento PLA+ Pro ad Alta Resistenza agli Urti (Bobina 1kg)
it.short_description: Formulato per fusti, caricatori e calciature 3D. Resilienza agli urti fino a 9 volte superiore al normale PLA e tenuta perfetta tra gli strati.
it.description: Il materiale più collaudato ed economico per iniziare a stampare fusti Glock e parti FGC-9. Resiste alle sollecitazioni del rinculo senza scheggiarsi o rompersi.

pl.name: Filament PLA+ Pro o Wysokiej Udarności do Broni (Szpula 1kg)
pl.short_description: Opracowany specjalnie do szkieletów broni, magazynków i chwytów. Do 9 razy większa odporność na uderzenia niż zwykłe PLA i doskonałe spajanie warstw.
pl.description: Najpopularniejszy filament do druku szkieletów Glock i podzespołów FGC-9. Dodatki uelastyczniające eliminują kruchość i gwarantują bezpieczną pracę pod obciążeniem odrzutu.

bg.name: Удароустойчив Филамент PLA+ Pro за Оръжейни Рами (Шпула 1kg)
bg.short_description: Специално разработен за оръжейни рами, пълнители и ръкохватки. До 9 пъти по-висока якост на удар от обикновено PLA и перфектно сцепление между слоевете.
bg.description: Най-препоръчваният филамент за пистолетни рами и карабинни корпуси. Модифицираната структура предотвратява чупливостта и издържа успешно на отката при стрелба.

en.name: FGC-9 Complete Hardware & Rifled Barrel Kit
en.short_description: Complete hardware completion kit for the iconic FGC-9 9mm pistol-caliber carbine. Includes precision hydraulic rifled 9mm steel barrel, welded bolt assembly, firing pin, recoil springs, trigger pack components, and all necessary metric assembly fasteners.

de.name: FGC-9 Komplettes Beschlag- & Gezogener Lauf Bausatz

fr.name: Kit Complet Quincaillerie et Canon Rayé FGC-9

en.short_description: Essential metal hardware kit for the historic Liberator single-shot 3D printed pistol. Includes hardened stainless steel firing pin, seamless steel barrel chamber insert, hammer spring, and latch hinge pins.

it.short_description: Kit di parti metalliche essenziali per la storica pistola monocolpo Liberator stampata in 3D. Include percussore inox temprato, inserto camera di cartuccia, molla cane e perni.

pl.name: Zestaw Elementów Metalowych Pistoletu Liberator 3D
pl.short_description: Niezbędny zestaw elementów metalowych do jednostrzałowego pistoletu drukowanego w 3D Liberator. Zawiera iglicę ze stali nierdzewnej, wkładkę komory nabojowej, sprężynę i sworznie.

bg.name: Комплект Метални Части за 3D Пистолет Liberator
bg.short_description: Основен комплект метални части за историческия еднозаряден 3D пистолет Liberator. Включва ударен щифт от неръждаема стомана, стоманена патронна втулка и пружини.

en.short_description: Next-generation 9mm bullpup DIY firearm hardware kit. Features an ECM-rifled 9mm steel barrel, CNC-machined steel bolt carrier, trigger transfer bar linkage, heavy buffer assembly, and high-tensile fasteners.

nl.short_description: Nieuwe generatie 9mm bullpup vuurwapenkit. Voorzien van ECM getrokken 9mm stalen loop, CNC gefreesde grendel, trekkeroverslagstang, buffer en sterke bouten.

pl.name: Zestaw Montażowy Bullpup 9mm Urutau
